description: This file defines internal futex synchronization primitives for Abseil, including platform-specific syscall wrappers and constants.

classes.name: FutexImpl
classes.description: Implements futex wait and wake operations using syscalls.

classes.name: Futex
classes.description: Derived class from FutexImpl, possibly for future extension or aliasing.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits on a futex until woken or timeout.

methods.name: WaitAbsoluteTimeout
methods.description: Waits on a futex until woken or an absolute timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitRelativeTimeout
methods.description: Waits on a futex until woken or a relative timeout occurs.

methods.name: Wake
methods.description: Wakes up to 'count' waiters on the futex.
